construction; this section tracks inline `<Shortcut>` mentions in

**Keyboard navigation**

- `Ctrl+Tab` — nav-next-tab
- `PgDown` — nav-nextrow-control
- `Ctrl+Shift+Tab` — nav-prev-tab
- `PgUp` — nav-prevrow-control

**Trackedit actions**

- `Shift+V` — Paste (pushes clips on selected track)
- `Ctrl+Alt+Shift+V` — Paste (preserves synchronization on all tracks)
- `Ctrl+Alt+V` — Paste (overlaps other clips)

**Tracks view navigation actions**

- `Ctrl+Home` — First track
- `Ctrl+End` — Last track
- `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+Return` — Track range selection
- `Ctrl+Enter` / `Ctrl+Return` — Add track or track item to selection
